info.title: JENRIKS public API
info.summary: Read-only JSON API, NLWeb endpoint and MCP server for the JENRIKS daily photoblog (one photo per day since 2006).
info.description: Everything here is public, read-only and free: no API key, no OAuth, no accounts, no write operations. Stable REST operations carry a major version in the path (/api/v1). Backward-compatible fields may be added within v1; breaking changes get a new major path. Before a version is removed, JENRIKS publishes a migration note at /developers/#versioning and signals it with RFC 9745 Deprecation and Link headers; a dated Sunset header is announced at least 90 days ahead. No sunset is scheduled. Search results page by offset or by an opaque cursor (next_cursor); POST /api/v1/batch runs up to 20 GET requests in one call. Every error is an RFC 9457 problem document (application/problem+json) with a stable code and a resolution hint. Quota: 120 requests per minute per client IP on /api, /mcp and /ask, advertised through RateLimit headers; a 429 carries Retry-After. Every page URL /x/y/ has a Markdown twin at /x/y.md (the homepage at /index.md); Accept: text/markdown or ?mode=agent on the page URL returns the same text, and machine documents wrap as /openapi.json.md, /server.json.md, /api/v1.md or /.well-known/<doc>.md. Photographs are copyrighted: credit the photographer and link the page; licensing via https://jenriks.com/contact/.

post.summary: Run up to 20 read-only GET requests in one call
post.description: Body: requests[] of {id, method, path}; only GET and paths under /api/v1/ (with a query string if needed) are allowed, and /api/v1/batch cannot be nested. The reply lists responses[] in request order with the sub-request's status and JSON body; a failing sub-request carries its RFC 9457 problem object as body while the outer status stays 200. One batch counts as one request against the rate limit. The endpoint is read-only, so a retry with the same Idempotency-Key returns fresh identical data; the key is echoed back for correlation only, nothing is stored.

200.description: Per-item status and body; the outer status is 200 even when items fail

400.description: Malformed batch: invalid JSON, empty or more than 20 requests, non-GET method, path outside /api/v1/ or /api/v1/batch inside a batch

post.summary: MCP server (JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP, JSON responses)
post.description: Methods: initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call, resources/list, resources/read. Tools: search_photos (offset or opaque cursor paging), get_photo, get_latest_photo (optional photographer), random_photo, get_site_overview (optional include list); each declares an outputSchema and every photo carries geo coordinates or null. Stateless: no sessions, no server-initiated event stream. Server card: /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json; registry manifest: /server.json.

parameters.name: MCP-Protocol-Version
parameters.description: MCP protocol version negotiated during initialize (2025-06-18, 2025-03-26 or 2024-11-05); echoed in the response header of the same name

200.description: JSON-RPC response (array when the request was a batch)

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details. Served as application/problem+json on every 4xx/5xx from /api, /mcp and the discovery documents, and on page URLs when the client accepts only JSON.

type.description: URI identifying the problem type; resolves to the matching entry in /developers/#errors

credit.description: Ready-made credit line: photographer, JENRIKS, page URL

geo.description: WGS 84 coordinates of the location when the post carries them, otherwise null

offset.description: Offset of the first returned row; 0 when a cursor was used

next_offset.description: Kept for offset paging; present when more matches exist

next_cursor.description: Opaque token for the next page; null on the last page. Send it back as cursor.

cursor.description: Echo of the cursor this page was fetched with, when one was sent

next.description: The same request with cursor=next_cursor and no offset; null on the last page

id.description: Client label echoed in the matching response

path.description: A v1 path with optional query string; /api/v1/batch itself is not allowed

responses.description: Same order and length as requests

status.description: HTTP status the sub-request would have returned on its own

body.description: The sub-request's JSON body, or its RFC 9457 problem object on 4xx/5xx

NlwebRequest.description: NLWeb 0.55 structured body; the flat legacy fields (query as a string, site, prev, streaming, mode, max_results) are accepted as well.

NlwebAnswer.description: NLWeb 0.55 non-streaming response: an answer with results, or a failure (HTTP 200) with an error object.

score.description: 100 for the best match, descending by rank

DidDocument.description: W3C DID document for did:web:jenriks.com; the Ed25519 key signs the AI catalog trust manifests.

TrustManifest.description: AI Catalog trust manifest (also used by ARD). Signed entries carry subject, issuedAt and a detached EdDSA JWS whose key is published in /.well-known/did.json.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque page token from next_cursor. Do not construct it; overrides offset when both are sent.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: draft-ietf-httpapi-idempotency-key-header: Structured Field String, UUID recommended, max 255 chars. The batch endpoint is read-only, so a replay returns fresh identical data; the key is accepted and echoed in the response so retries can be correlated. No replay store exists.

Deprecation.description: RFC 9745. Present only on deprecated operations; absent while nothing is deprecated. Structured Field Date: seconds since the epoch with an @ prefix.

Sunset.description: RFC 8594. Present only when removal is scheduled, never earlier than Deprecation, announced at least 90 days ahead; absent while no sunset is scheduled. HTTP-date in GMT.

Link.description: RFC 8288 links: service-desc (this document), service-doc (/developers/), api-catalog, plus rel="deprecation" pointing at the migration note and rel="sunset" once a Sunset date is set
